title: Factory
description: The inbox, the senses, triage and the gateway: what is waiting, what arrives, how long it takes and what it costs.

panels.title: Signals waiting
panels.description: Signals in the inbox that triage has not yet taken. Metric factory_inbox_waiting (gauge), set by triage.

panels.title: Signals in the period
panels.description: Signals the senses have left in the inbox over the time shown. Metric factory_signals_total{sense} (counter), from the intake and the log watcher.

panels.title: Signal to ticket, median
panels.description: Time from a signal reaching the inbox to triage making it a ticket. Metric factory_triage_signal_to_ticket_seconds (histogram), observed by triage.

panels.title: Gateway spend in the period
panels.description: What the gateway has spent on models over the time shown, in US dollars. Metric factory_gateway_spend_usd_total (counter), counted by the gateway.

panels.title: Inbox depth
panels.description: Signals waiting for triage over time. Metric factory_inbox_waiting (gauge), set by triage. A line that climbs and stays up means triage has stopped taking signals.

panels.title: Signals by sense
panels.description: Signals left in the inbox each minute, by the sense that found them: probe, crawler, metrics, logs or report. Metric factory_signals_total{sense} (counter).

panels.title: From signal to ticket
panels.description: Time from a signal reaching the inbox to triage making it a ticket. Metric factory_triage_signal_to_ticket_seconds (histogram).

panels.title: Gateway spend
panels.description: What the gateway has spent on models, in US dollars, summed over the time shown. Metric factory_gateway_spend_usd_total (counter).

panels.title: The factory's logs
panels.description: What the intake and the log watcher say about themselves. They never log what a visitor wrote.
